provider: Google Cloud Storage Always Free tier

free_tier.stated: 5 GB-months of regional storage (US regions only) + 5,000 Class A ops + 50,000 Class B ops per month.

egress.terms: 100 GB/month outbound to all destinations excluding China/Australia — described in the Always Free table as '100 GB of outbound data transfer from North America'. Beyond that it is $0.12/GiB, metered.

tooling: Native S3-interoperable XML API + JSON API; rclone 'gcs' backend; gsutil/gcloud storage; signed URLs; HMAC keys make it literally S3.
chaining: 5 GB x N projects. Project creation is capped (~30 default before requesting increase) and soft-deleted projects still count for 30 days, so the practical ceiling is a few hundred GB, not TiB.
limits_note: 5 GB stored, 100 GB/mo egress, free tier restricted to us-east1/us-west1/us-central1; 5 TiB max object; anonymous writes are correctly refused.
